== Starting out ==

[[File:Familiar_Eridani_and_Asphodene.png|thumb|400px|The twin protagonists, Asphodene (left) and Eridani (right)]]
Once you have entered a map with The Stars Above mod installed you will be given a [[Spatial Disk|Spatial Disk]]. Upon interacting with the disk you will be greeted by the twin protagonists, Asphodene (left) and Eridani (right). You will have to choose between the two and once the decision is made depending on which side you choose, you will be granted the permanent effect [[File:Umbral_Icon.png]] or [[File:Astral_Icon.png]] which will select which type of weapon you will be able to use. After doing the permanent decision to choose one of the starefarers you can use the Left-Click button to engage in small talk with the starfarer. But when Right-Clicking a menu will pop up with a few options, these are: 

[[File:Stellar_Array_Icon.png|thumb|left|500px]]

==Stellar Array==

The [[Stellar Array|Stellar Array]] is a power given to you by your starfarer allowing you to activate certain abilities. There are 3 types of abilities from tier 1 to 3, the tier 1 abilities consume only 1 point from a total of 5, the tier 2 abilities consume 2 points, and the tier 3 consumes 3 points. The '''Stellar Array''' gives the player the option to change the damage that their held Aspected weapon will deal, the damage will be decreased by 10% if the damage type is changed.



[[File:Stellar_Nova_Icon.png|thumb|left|500px|]]

==Stellar Nova==

The Stellar Nova is a special ability that is used by the Starfarer. here you can change the selected [[Stellar Novas|Stellar Nova]]. It can be activated by pressing the {{key|stellar nova}} (default: {{key|Z}}). Stellar Novas can only be activated upon gathering sufficient Stellar Nova Energy to fill the Nova Gauge. Stellar Nova energy accumulates gradually in combat at a rate of roughly 1/s. Defeating enemies has a chance to drop Starlight, which will give the player 5 Stellar Nova Energy automatically.



[[File:Voyage_Icon.png|thumb|The twin protagonists, Asphodene (left) and Eridani (right)|left|500px|]]

==Astrolabe==

The '''Astrolabe''' is used for traveling into the [[Cosmic Voyages|Subworlds]]. Upon interacting with this button, the '''Celestial Cartography''' map will appear which will show all locations which the player can visit. Each Subworld has a threat level, which can range from none to A-. For visiting a Subworld with a higher threat level the player will need to upgrade the Stellaglyph to a higher tier. Though for the visit of places with a threat level of none you can do it without a Stellaglyph.     '''It should be noted that Subworlds do not work in multiplayer'''.


[[File:Archive_Icon.png|thumb|The twin protagonists, Asphodene (left) and Eridani (right)|left|500px|]]

==Archive==

The [[Archive|Archive]] is used for the playback of messages and also to get back specific items like [[Essences|Essences]] or [[Mnemonic Traces|Mnemonic Traces]] and even boss summoning items.

systems.Stellar Array:
[[File:Stellar Array Icon.png|Stellar Array Icon]]

{{quotation|Asphodene|"You can access the Stellar Array from here. We can equip passive abilities here, staying mindful of the max cost, as well as changing the damage type of Aspected Weapons."| iconfirst=y }} 

The "'Stellar Array"' is a power given to you by the [[Starfarers]]. Once you choose your Starfarer, you can access the Stellar Array by {{key|open}} the [[Spatial Disk]], then clicking the Stellar Array Icon.

In the Stellar Array, you may equip special abilities gained after beating certain bosses, or you may change the damage type your Aspected Weapon does.

You can equip as many abilities as you want, from any tier, and in any combination you want, so long as you have unlocked them and the total point value is under or equal to 5. This value can be increased by 1 point by equipping the [[Attire of the Faerie Voyager]].
It is also increased by 1 if playing with Calamity after the Devourer of Gods has been defeated.

The player can also change the damage that their held Aspected weapon will deal but the damage will be decreased by 10% if the damage type is changed.

== Abilities ==
At the moment, there are 24 abilities to choose from, split between three tiers. Each tier has a different cost for equipping, with Tier 1 costing 1 point, Tier 2 costing 2 points, and Tier 3 costing 3 points.

There are 12 Tier 1 abilities, 8 Tier 2 abilities and 4 Tier 3 abilities.

systems.Stellar Novas:
[[File:Stellar Nova Icon.png|thumb|Stellar Nova icon in Starfarer Menu]]

'''Stellar Novas''' are activated abilities first unlocked after defeating the [[The Vagrant of Space and Time]]. They are activated by pressing the {{key|stellar nova}} (default: {{key|Z}}). Stellar Novas can only be activated upon gathering sufficient Stellar Nova Energy to fill the Nova Gauge. Stellar Nova energy accumulates gradually in combat at a rate of roughly 1/s. Defeating enemies has a chance to drop Starlight, which will give the player 5 Stellar Nova Energy automatically. Stellar Novas usually deal damage, but also provide additional effects to help in combat.

You can change Stellar Novas in the [[Spatial Disk|Spatial Disk]] as well as affixing [[Stellar Prisms]] which can modify some stats or effects of Stellar Novas.


Stellar Nova damage scales with boss progression:

*No bosses defeated: 100 base damage
*King Slime: 150 base damage
*Eye of Cthulhu: 220 base damage
*Evil Boss (Brain of Cthulhu/Eater of Worlds): 300 base damage
*Skeletron: 400 base damage
*Wall of Flesh: 900 base damage
*Any Mechanical Boss: 1450 base damage
*All Mechanical Bosses: 2350 base damage
*Plantera: 3050 base damage
*Golem: 4000 base damage
*Lunar Cultist: 5200 base damage
*Moon Lord: 6600 base damage
*The Warrior Of Light: 7150 base damage


There are currently 9 Stellar Novas in The Stars Above.

== Stellar Novas ==

'''{{item|Prototokia Aster|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after defeating [[The Vagrant of Space and Time]]. 
* It summons a sword that flies above the player and goes towards the cursor after a few seconds. When the sword comes in contact with an enemy it inflicts Void Atrophy for 30s, which deals damage over time and can stack. On a critical hit a portion of the cost is refunded. You can cast it 2 times per activation, each cast dealing 50% of the damage in the Stellar Nova menu.
* {{aspect|a}}: You can cast for free 1 more time for 25% of the damage in the menu. The third cast does not inflict Void Atrophy.
* {{aspect|u}}: The second hit gives you a +400% damage boost for 5s, but Void Atrophy doesn't stack.
<!-- * '''Base Statistics:'''
** Base damage: 1x
** Effect duration: 12.5x
** Cost: 100
** Critical chance: 50
** Critical damage modifier: 1.45x -->


'''{{item|Unlimited Blade Works|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after defeating the world evil boss, ([[Eater of Worlds]]/[[Brain of Cthulhu]]).
* When cast it creates an empowering field for 20 seconds, and rain down a barrage of blades, reducing damage dealt by enemies by 10% for 20 seconds on hit. All allies within the radius of the empowering field will gain the "Bladeforged" buff which increases damage, knockback critical strike chance and armor penetration by 2% up to 10% depending on the player's current HP (capped at 500 HP.) Duration in seconds is proportional to Effect Duration plus 15% of Energy Cost.
*{{aspect|a}}: Bladeforged's cap is raised to 15% and now increases defense based on percentage values up to 8. Additionally, Bladeforged perists for 10 seconds after the Nova ends.
*{{aspect|u}}: Bladeforged no longer increases damage, but attacking with projectiles trigger follow-up attacks (3 second cooldown.) Foes within the field take 10% more damage.


'''{{item|Guardian's Light|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after visiting a meteorite or after defeating [[Skeletron]].
* The Stellar Nova acts differently depending on the player's Aspected damage type: Thundercrash if Melee, Golden Gun if Ranged, Nova Bomb if Magic, Needlestorm if Summoner, and Silence and Squall otherwise.
** Thundercrash: Upon activation, gain Bearer of Light for 10 seconds and fly towards your cursor, dealing incredibly powerful damage to the first foe struck. Gain Invincibility for 3 seconds upon activation, independent of the attack's duration.
** Golden Gun: Upon activation, gain Bearer of Light for 10 seconds while unleashing a bolt of piercing light. You can press the Stellar Nova key 2 more times to repeat the attack while Bearer of Light is active, dealing 1/3 damage each. Critical strikes explode, dealing 50% base damage.
** Nova Bomb: Upon activation, gain Bearer of Light for 10 seconds while unleashing a powerful void projectile that tracks foes. After 2 seconds or after striking a foe, the attack will detonate in a large explosion. Inflicts Shadowflame for 10 seconds on foes struck by the blast.
** Needlestorm: Upon activation, gain Bearer of Darkness for 10 seconds and unleash 5 Woven Needles. After striking a foe or a surface, the needles weave into Threadlings and attack nearby foes (treated as minions.) Damage is split between Woven Needles and Threadlings.
** Silence and Squall: Upon activation, gain Bearer of Darkness for 10 seconds while unleashing Silence, inflicting Frostburn for 8 seconds. Instantly follow up with Squall, dealing damage while creating a frost field on impact that deals damage over time for 8 seconds.
* {{aspect|a}}: Bearer of Light increases health regeneration. Bearer of Darkness reduces damage taken by 10%. Taking lethal damage during either buff will instead consume the buff and restore 30 HP.
* {{aspect|u}}: Bearer of Light increases damage by 8%. Bearer of Darkness increases critical strike damage by 15%. While either buff is active, Aspected Damage Type penalty is negated.


'''{{item|Kiwami Ryuken|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after defeating [[Mechanical Boss|any Mechanical boss]]. 
* Upon activation you get a 1s window to get hit and become Invincible. If you do get hit a counterattack will trigger, dealing a lot of damage to enemies close to you, in the direction of your cursor. The counterattack only applies if the enemy is close. If you don't get hit 50% of the cost will be refunded.
* {{aspect|a}}: The counterattack is always a critical hit and you get 5 Stellar Nova Energy upon triggering it.
* {{aspect|u}}: The counterattack gives you 40 HP and 40 mana and if it doesn't trigger the refund is increased by 10 Stellar Nova Energy.


'''{{item|Garden of Avalon|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after defeating [[Penthesilea, the Witch of Ink]]. 
* Upon activation you get powerful health and mana regeneration which scales with the heal strength in the Stellar Nova menu and 2s of invincibility. If the cast is critical you gain health with the amount being affected by Stellar Nova crit modifiers and the "Solemn Aegis" buff for 15s. Solemn Aegis negates 1 hit independently of Invincibility.
* {{aspect|a}}: Invincibility lasts for 4s instead of 2 and you get healed for 100 HP upon casting.
* {{aspect|u}}: You gain the "Dreamlike Charisma" buff upon casting which increases damage by 32% if you have over 100 mana and by 16% if you don't.


'''{{item|Firefly Type-IV|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after defeating [[Asphodene and Eridani]]. 
* After a short delay, your Starfarer dons the Chrysalid Pyronexus and assists you in battle. All attacks deal 2 separate instances of Nova damage. Repeated strikes build Complete Combustion, dealing the Nova's crit damage (Calculated as a crit.) once resolved. Critical Nova strikes inflict Complete Combustion much faster, but crits do not deal increased damage. 5% of Energy Cost is added to Nova duration. One instance of Complete Combustion is guaranteed in the finishing strike.
* {{aspect|a}}: Pressing the Stellar Nova key while the Nova is not at full charge or active will allow you to immediately unleash the finishing strike on a nearby foe (90s cooldown)
* {{aspect|u}}: You can continue to gain Stellar Nova Energy while Firefly-Type IV is active.


'''{{item|Ars Laevateinn|nolink=y|anchor=y}}'''  is unlocked after defeating [[Nalhaun, The Burnished King]]. 
* It summons a giant sword that spins 5 times, dealing 20% of the damage in the Stellar Nova menu. During this time you will also be granted the "Sutrt's Twilight" buff which makes all your attacks burn enemies. Burned enemies take extra damage from Ars Laevateinn.
* {{aspect|a}}: Burned enemies take more damage, which increases further if the attack was a critical hit.
* {{aspect|u}}: Surtr's Twilight also gives a +10% damage boost and mana regeneration.


'''{{item|Edin Genesis Quasar|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after defeating [[Tsukiyomi, the First Starfarer]].
* It first immobilizes the player, making them Invincible for the time. Afterwards it gives them the "Astrate Driver" buff for 25s. Astrate Driver gives the player infinite flight time and 3 Cosmic Charges. All attacks while Astrate Driver is active will inherit the nova's stats. If you have a Cosmic Charge pressing the Stellar Nova key while Astrate Driver is active will launch a barrage of projectiles, consuming one Cosmic Charge.
* {{aspect|a}}: Critical hits will do an additional 2020 damage and you will gain a Cosmic Charge after defeating an enemy with a critical hit, with a cap of 5 charges.
* {{aspect|u}}: Attacks will also execute any enemy with less then 2020 HP, and expending a Cosmic Charge will grant you 1s of Invincibility.


'''{{item|Origin's Infinity|nolink=y|anchor=y}}''' is unlocked after obtaining [[Zenith]]. 
* Your Starfarer unveils the Unlimited Sword, targetting the foe with the highest Max HP (prioritizes bosses.) After a delay, deals true damage that pierces all forms of invincibility. If piercing invincibility, Nova bonuses do not apply. Inflict Chain Attack: if other players use Stellar Nova against the foe, damage is increased by 5% of base Nova scaling. Chain Attack duration is based on Effect Duration. Additionally, foe defense is set to 0 during Chain Attack.
* {{aspect|a}}: When allies use their Nova to trigger Chain Attack, they heal 7% HP. Additionally, heal an extra 5 HP per living ally.
* {{aspect|u}}: When allies use their Nova to trigger Chain Attack, they gain 3 Stellar Nova Energy. Additionally, gain an extra 1 Stellar Nova Energy per living ally.

== Trivia ==

* Ars Laevateinn is a reference to the weapon of the character Surtr from Arknights.
* Kiwami Ryuken is a reference to Yakuza: Like a Dragon.
* Garden of Avalon and its Umbral bonus, Dreamlike Charisma, is a direct reference to Merlin from Fate/Grand Order.
* Edin Genesis Quasar and its buff, Astarte Driver, is a reference to Space Ishtar of Fate/Grand Order.
* Unlimited Blade Works is a reference to the "Fate/Stay Night" visual novel.
* Guardian's Light is a reference to the video games Destiny, Destiny 2 made by Bungie.
* Firefly Type-IV is a reference to the character Firefly and her mech-suit SAM from Honkai: Star Rail.
systems.Cosmic Voyages:
Cosmic Voyages are a unique feature of the mod, allowing the player to visit various mini-Dungeons, also known as subworlds, which help the player gather various resources, including {{item|Prismatic Core|Prismatic Cores}}, {{item|Banded Tenebrium}}, and {{item|Inert Shard|Inert Shards}}. Upon entering any subworld, the player will be affected with the [[Cosmic Voyager]] debuff, restricting them from using Wings, Mounts, Explosives, and the {{item|Rod of Discord}} as well as disallowing any interaction with blocks. Some subworlds apply additional effects. Cosmic Voyages can be accessed after interacting with the player's Starfarer once [[King Slime]] has been defeated. Players can access Cosmic Voyages Menu either by a placed [[Stellaglyphs|Stellaglyph]], or by {{image|Voyage Icon.png|size=50px}}Celestial Cartography icon in [[Spatial Disk]] menu. == Mini-Dungeons == === Before Stellaglyph === These mini-dungeons can be accessed without a '''Stellaglyph'''. ==== [[Observatory Hyperborea]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerObservatoryHyperborea.png|300px|right]] ''"One of the many observatories dotting the Moirae Galaxy- and one your Starfarer calls home. Each Observatory is home to a magical conduit called a {{item|Celestriad Root}}."'' === Stellaglyph (Tier 1) === These mini-dungeons require a {{item|Stellaglyph (Tier 1)}} or higher tier of stellaglyph to access. ==== [[Cygnus Asteroid Field]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerCygnusAsteroidField.png|300px|right]] ''"A collection of marble asteroids, notable for their strange foreign ruins- possibly a clue to their original inhabitants, yet the passage of time has rendered archeology impossible."'' Source of {{item|Prismatic Core|Prismatic Cores}}. ==== [[Mining Station Aries]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerMiningStationAries.png|300px|right]] ''"A long-abandoned mining station positioned on the hollowed-out husk of a forgotten planet. Sights like this are common the further away you stray from the galaxy's center."'' Source of {{item|Prismatic Core|Prismatic Cores}}. === Stellaglyph (Tier 2) === These mini-dungeons require a {{item|Stellaglyph (Tier 2)}} or higher tier of stellaglyph to access. ==== [[Caelum]] ==== [[File:CaelumBiomeBanner.png|300px|right]] ''"It is unknown what sapped this planet of life, but it exists now as a shell of its former self: a chalky white lonely world. This world has a secondary unlock requirement, having spoken with a projection of [[Garridine]] found in the [[Neon Veil]]. Upon talking with her, she will direct you to visit. A passive world where Garridine resides, where she will inquire for various items from the player's gameplay in return for Stellar Foci. Contributed by: Izanagi, The wanderer of stars"'' Source of {{item|Prismatic Core|Prismatic Cores}}. ==== [[Ultra Plant]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerUltraPlant.png|300px|right]] ''"A unknown locale populated with strange figures both inert and living. The constant bursts of electricity provides a hostile evironment to traverse and explore. Contributed by: Hockerzocker"'' Chests have a small chance to contain the {{item|Electric Guitar Pick}}. === Stellaglyph (Tier 3) === These mini-dungeons require a {{item|Stellaglyph (Tier 3)}} to access. ==== [[Fallen Theranhad]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerFallenTheranhad.png|300px|right]] ''"A floating archipelago left abandoned after its emperor became the vessel to a malevolent cosmic deity. A dark energy permeates the air. Contributed by: hakomari"'' Source of {{item|Prismatic Core|Prismatic Cores}}. ==== [[Faint Archives]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerFaintArchives.png|300px|right]] ''"A strange, pristine locale sitting utop a cloudy expanse. The walls are home to myriad secrets and mysteries, some which threaten to come apart at the seams. Contributed by: UnkownSToast"'' Chests have a rare chance to contain the {{item|Fragment of Lost Memory}}. ==== [[The Dreaming City]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerDreamingCity.png|300px|right]] ''"A majestic stronghold once populated by a long forgotten race. It is plagued by hostile entites suffused with paracausal darkness, and is oft drifting between another plane of existence. Contributed by: Tatriskel"'' Source of {{item|Stellar Remnant|Stellar Remnants}}. Staying on the planet will teleport the player to [[Katabasis]], where [[Arbitration]] spawns. ==== [[Lyra]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerLyra.png|300px|right]] ''"A strange planet known as Anomaly Iota. It is recorded emitting strange, powerful vibrations periodically akin to a beating heart. Exploration is limited due to a highly acidic surface."'' Source of {{item|Prismatic Core|Prismatic Cores}}. Staying on the planet will teleport the player to [[Katabasis]], where [[Arbitration]] spawns. === Others === These places are not accessable by Cosmic Voyages menu, but technically players are in Cosmic Voyages status in these mini-dungeons. ==== [[Katabasis]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerKatabasis.png|300px|right]] This mini-dungeon is the arena for fighting [[Arbitration]]. Players can access this mini-dungeon passively by lingering too long in Cosmic Voyages marked as Anomaly, or actively by using [[The Beating Crux]].
==== [[Eternal Confluence]] ==== [[File:BiomeBannerEternalConfluence.png|300px|right]] This mini-dungeon is the arena for fighting [[Tsukiyomi, the First Starfarer]]. Players can access this mini-dungeon by using [[Mnemonic Sigil]].

=== Currently Inaccessible === These mini-dungeons have no way to access them yet. ==== Aquarius ==== [[File:CompassAquarius.png|75px|right]] ''"An ocean planet covered entirely in water. While it does not sustain intelligent life, the geothermal conduction beneath the waves means some life can still persist, even deep within the Ardor."'' ==== Antlia ==== [[File:CompassAntlia.png|75px|right]] ''"A colossal gas giant with no surface. Even close proximity would mean instant death due to the overwhelming force of it's gravity."'' == Trivia == * Although placing tiles is intended to be forbidden, there are some flaws in current 1.4.3.6 version, allowing the player to place and remove wire and actuators and create tombstones after death. * Also, prevention of explosion results in conflict with certain map design. In Corvus, there are a group of chests requiring the player to trigger a series of explosives and break the floor and ceiling of the building. However, that explosion is prevented from breaking the tiles, and thus the chest can't be accessed by intended puzzle. ** However, combining the two features, the Corvus explosive puzzle can be solved by setting up wires and actuators and de-actuating the tiles. * Despite [[Clentaminator]] usage being banned in subworlds, usage of the [[Terraformer]] is not restricted. * Although the Rod of Discord cannot be used in subworlds, using the [[Weapon Memories|Pearlescent Orb]] to teleport still works.

[[File:Aspects.png|thumb|Astral, Spatial, and Umbral Icons]]

Aspects are weapon types that correspond to a [[Starfarers|Starfarer]]. Once a starfarer is selected, a status effect named either "Astral Resonance" or "Umbral Resonance" will always be present.

The Astral Aspect corresponds to [[Asphodene]], and the Umbral Aspect corresponds to [[Eridani]]. The Spatial Aspect is an aspect type that can be used by both Starfarers.
